content.title: Clinical Labs Hope to Head Off Looming Medicare Cuts
content.summary: FEATURE  U.S. House representatives heard the clinical lab industry plead yesterday for a reprieve from looming cuts as large as 15% in what Medicare pays Labcorp Holdings Quest Diagnostics and cancer-testing specialists like Guardant Health Exact Sciences and Natera  Starting February, a current law will require labs to tell Medicare the rates that private insurers paid for tests back in 2019.

content.title: Guardant Health Catapults 234%; Sets Up With Strong Sales Outlook
content.summary: Medical services stock Guardant Health is Thursday's selection for IBD 50 Stocks To Watch after catapulting 234% in 2025, thanks to steady sales growth for its noninvasive cancer screening and diagnostic services.  Guardant Health stock recently broke out of a flat base at a buy point of 112.43.  For the September-ended quarter, the company reported a loss of 39 cents per share, though sales growth accelerated for the second straight period to $265.2 million.
